component.name: Bandwidth Logger
component.summary: Run internet speed tests on a schedule and keep a complete record

description.p: Bandwidth Logger measures your internet connection at an interval you choose and keeps a permanent, timestamped record of every test on this computer. It is built for diagnosing slowdowns that come and go: instead of one reading taken when you happened to notice a problem, you get a history you can look through and export.
Every attempted test is recorded, including ones that failed:

ul.li: Run a test immediately, or on a schedule from 5 minutes to 24 hours
Keep testing in the background after the window is closed
See download, upload, latency, jitter, packet loss, server and provider
Inspect the complete stored record for any test, including failures
Export everything, or a date range, to a CSV file

description.p: Nothing leaves your computer except the speed test itself. There is no account, no cloud service and no analytics, and the application never needs administrator rights to run.
Added a test server setting, so results stay comparable over time instead of shifting when the engine picks a different server.
Removed the fallback speed-test engine, which under-reported speed on fast connections, and corrected the instructions for installing the Ookla engine on Ubuntu 24.04.
